profile.headline: Working hard to make my dreams a reality.
profile.summary:
I’m an IT professional who thrives at the intersection of technology and customer service. Over the course of my career, I’ve learned that technical expertise alone isn’t enough—what truly makes a difference is the ability to listen, communicate clearly, and deliver solutions that empower people to do their best work. That’s where I excel.
My background spans system engineering, technical support, project coordination, and customer-facing service roles, giving me a unique perspective on how technology impacts both organizations and individuals. Whether I’m troubleshooting a complex networking issue, scripting an automation to streamline workflows, or walking a non-technical colleague through a new tool, I approach every challenge with patience, clarity, and a focus on outcomes.
At Microsoft, I was recognized multiple times for my ability to simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences, earning MVP and NPS awards for customer impact. At Symphony AI, I expanded my skills into automation, documentation, and cross-team collaboration, producing training materials and walkthroughs that made technical processes accessible to a wide range of users. Beyond my professional roles, I’ve also contributed to community events like Twin Cities Pride, where I coordinated volunteers and logistics—further sharpening my organizational and communication skills.
I hold advanced degrees in Computer Science (AI & Machine Learning) and IT Management, along with certifications including CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+, Project+ and PMI CAPM. These credentials reflect not only my technical foundation but also my commitment to continuous learning and professional growth.
What drives me most is the opportunity to bridge the gap between people and technology. I believe that great IT support isn’t just about fixing problems—it’s about building trust, reducing friction, and enabling others to succeed. I take pride in being approachable, detail-oriented, and proactive, whether I’m supporting end users, collaborating with colleagues, or designing solutions that improve efficiency.
Looking ahead, I’m excited to continue growing in roles where I can combine my technical expertise, customer service mindset, and problem-solving skills to make a meaningful impact. If you’re looking for someone who can bring both technical depth and a people-first approach to IT, I’d love to connect.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: I started my own indie video game company, developing software applications on the side in my free time and I recently released my first app on Android.

positions.title: Information Technology Technician
positions.description: Performed system administration tasks including user account provisioning, permissions management, and routine server maintenance. Configured and maintained Active Directory environments, including OU structure updates, group policy adjustments, and security group assignments. Diagnosed and repaired workstations, laptops, and peripheral hardware, ensuring minimal downtime and reliable performance. Resolved support tickets across hardware, software, and network issues with a focus on fast turnaround and clear communication. Installed, updated, and troubleshot enterprise applications and operating systems across Windows environments. Managed network connectivity issues, including workstation onboarding, IP configuration, and basic switch/router troubleshooting. Provided end‑user training and technical guidance, improving user confidence and reducing repeat incidents. Documented technical procedures, fixes, and system changes to support team knowledge sharing and consistent workflows.

positions.title: System Engineer
positions.description:
•	Provide comprehensive administrative support to the team, including managing calendars, coordinating meetings, and preparing reports.
•	Handle all incoming and outgoing correspondence, ensuring timely and accurate communication.
•	Maintain and organize office files, both electronic and physical, to ensure easy access and retrieval.
•	Assist in the preparation of presentations, spreadsheets, and other documents as needed.
•	Provide excellent customer service to clients and visitors, addressing inquiries and resolving issues promptly.
•	Supporting customers with issues with the various tools that Symphony AI makes, entering bugs into the system to get fixed in a future update.
•	Design and implementation of end solutions for customers.
•	Technical documentation for both internal and external systems for employees and customers.
•	Delivered effective verbal and written messages explaining technical concepts to non-technical business partners.
•	User Interface Design / mockup using Figma and other tools.
•	Some database administration both internally and for customers.
•	System Administration tasks for both internal systems and for customers occasionally.
•	Quality assurance tasks testing out fixes that have been developed.
•	Reproduction of bugs and other issues.
•	C#, HTML, Angular coding on various projects.
•	Project Management tasks as needed.

positions.title: System Engineer
positions.description: Designed and deployed IT solutions across Linux and Windows environments, including support for enterprise-grade video conferencing infrastructure. Developed automation scripts and internal applications in Java, C#, and Python to streamline AV system diagnostics and reporting. Supported Kubernetes-based deployments and containerized applications, including AV monitoring tools and collaboration platforms. Collaborated with Facilities and Security teams to optimize AV room setups and ensure compliance with organizational standards. Authored technical documentation and SOPs for AV system maintenance, hybrid meeting support, and preventive troubleshooting. Independently configured and maintained Microsoft Teams Rooms and Zoom Rooms, integrating Polycom and Crestron hardware. Provided as-built documentation and training to junior engineers on AV workflows and conferencing best practices. Troubleshot complex, mixed-media conferencing issues across distributed enterprise environments.

positions.title: Support Engineer
positions.description: At Microsoft as a Support Engineer my role was to troubleshoot the issues the customers were having with various Azure Networking components and determine a solution that meets their needs.

positions.title: Service Adviser
positions.description: At the Microsoft Store my job as a Service Advisor is to take the challenges of technology and find solutions for customer's both commercial and consumer.  I take the difficult tasks and concepts and break them down to a level everybody can understand.  I am a 1 time MVP and lead my store in various metrics for my department.

positions.title: Co Founder, Co CEO, Lead Programmer
positions.description: This has been a parttime endeavour to start a Indie Video Game Studio, as the only programmer for the team I am solely responsible for writing code.  In the 3 years I have been working on this team my greatest accomplishment has been to develop a game engine.  This engine has been built for 2D games and I am currently using it to develop both a Platformer as well as a 2D top down RPG. My work on this engine is available on my github page: https://github.com/darcsider/DarcMagik

positions.title: Build Your Own Sales
positions.description: My job at Microcenter was to define solutions to customers computer needs, this ranged from needing to repair / upgrade a current computer or to plan out the build for a new computer.  This involved discussing the customers current situation and what needs they may have in the near future.

positions.title: Retail Sales
positions.description: I sell computers, printers, and other office electronics.

positions.title: Lead QA Tester
positions.description: During my time at Destineer Studios I have been a part of testing more titles than I care to count.  I worked with everybody from all areas of the company and the development process.  In my time I have learned so much about game development, console development and all the standards that go along with them.

positions.title: Sales
positions.description: Selling computers, software, tv's, networking components, and other electronics.

positions.title: Retail Sales
positions.description: This was a seasonal position where I sold the clothing and accesories that Hot Topic sells.
